  STEP 1: Purge Cloudflare Cache (MANUAL - 5 minutes) 🔴
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  • Open: https://dash.cloudflare.com/
  • Select: pim.technostationery.com
  • Go to: Caching → Purge Cache
  • Click: "Purge Everything"
  • Wait: 1-2 minutes for propagation


  STEP 2: Verify Patches Load (10 minutes) ✅
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cd /home/pim/public_html/webapp
  node bypass_cache_test.js
  
  Expected output:
    ✅ window.r exists: ✅
    ✅ r.initialize exists: ✅
    ✅ r.initialize error: ✅ NO (FIXED!)

  If patches not loading:
    • Wait 5 more minutes for Cloudflare propagation
    • Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Delete)
    • Test in incognito mode
    • See troubleshooting: NEXT_SESSION_PRIORITIES.md


  STEP 3: Phase 9 - Webpack Rebuild (60 minutes) 🔧
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cd /home/pim/public_html
  
  # Check prerequisites
  node --version    # Should be >= 14.x
  yarn --version    # Should be installed
  
  # Rebuild assets (may take 10-20 minutes)
  yarn run webpack:build
  
  # Clear caches
  php bin/console cache:clear --env=prod
  php bin/console cache:warmup --env=prod
  sudo systemctl restart ea-php83-php-fpm
  varnishadm "ban req.url ~ ."
  
  # Verify
  cd /home/pim/public_html/webapp
  node phase_9_12_implementation.js
  # Check: __webpack_require__ should be defined ✅


  STEP 4: Phase 10 - Register Modules (30 minutes) 📦
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cd /home/pim/public_html
  
  # Install Symfony assets
  php bin/console assets:install public --symlink --env=prod
  
  # Verify bundles
  ls -la public/bundles/ | grep -E "(pimui|oro|akeneo)"
  # Should show: pimui, oro*, akeneo* directories
  
  # Clear caches
  php bin/console cache:clear --env=prod
  sudo systemctl restart ea-php83-php-fpm
  
  # Verify
  cd /home/pim/public_html/webapp
  node phase_9_12_implementation.js
  # Check: RequireJS modules > 50 ✅


  STEP 5: Phase 11-12 - Initialize & Verify (30 minutes) 🚀

  Expected results:

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          🆘 TROUBLESHOOTING                                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Problem: Patches not loading after Cloudflare purge
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Solution:
    1. Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Delete)
    2. Test in incognito mode
    3. Check DevTools → Network tab for r-initialize-patch.js
    4. Verify file returns 200 (not 404 or 304)
    5. Check console for: "[Akeneo Patch] Applying r.initialize fix..."

  Problem: Webpack build fails
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Solution:
    1. Check Node.js version: node --version (need >= 14.x)
    2. Reinstall: rm -rf node_modules && yarn install
    3. Check specific error message
    4. See: NEXT_SESSION_PRIORITIES.md → Troubleshooting

  Problem: Tests show unexpected results
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Solution:
    1. Check JSON output files: *_results.json
    2. Review screenshots: *.png
    3. Check browser console in manual test
    4. Verify services: sudo systemctl status ea-php83-php-fpm varnish

  Problem: Need to rollback changes
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Solution:
    cd /home/pim/public_html
    
    # Rollback template
    cp vendor/akeneo/pim-community-dev/src/Akeneo/Platform/Bundle/UIBundle/Resources/views/index.html.twig \
       src/AppBundle/Resources/views/PimUI/index.html.twig
    
    # Remove patch files
    rm public/js/r-initialize-patch.js
    rm public/js/extensions.json
    
    # Clear caches
    php bin/console cache:clear --env=prod
    sudo systemctl restart ea-php83-php-fpm
    varnishadm "ban req.url ~ ."
